mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increase present value of future earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
